steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
List. Each quality hold, machine state and open issue is stacked for the next shift.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Quality hold with no reference
findings.fix: Add the hold reference before the shift ends

findings.title: Machine state with no time
findings.fix: Record the time of the state

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] hold-q-0412.md:12  Quality hold with no reference.
       Fix: Add the hold reference before the shift ends.
[medium] machine-line-a.md:19  Machine state with no time.
       Fix: Record the time of the state.
[medium] issue-1.md:26  Issue with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Machines not in the log.
pros: Checks a quality hold with no reference, a machine state with no time, and an issue with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Machines not in the log.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-shift-handover skill on the records for this review.
